connector.name: Shodai Agreements
connector.registryDescription: Author, validate, deploy, and operate Shodai on-chain agreements.
connector.summary: Hosted at shodai.network over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace network.shodai. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
